name: Donchian Breakout

changelog.description: Donchian(20) channel breakout with EMA trend gate and volume confirmation. Thesis: price breaking 20-period high/low is a genuine breakout signal; EMA alignment filters false breakouts in ranging markets. Modeled on 151-strategies S8 (Donchian breakout).

backtest_90d.verdict: DISABLED — marginal PF=1.016 insufficient to enable. Lowest MaxDD of the 3 (17.71%) is promising. Re-test in trending market regime before enabling.

description: 20-period Donchian channel breakout. Price above 20-day high = LONG, below 20-day low = SHORT. EMA trend gate (weight=1) filters choppy breakouts. Volume spike confirms conviction.
